create-awesome.title: Create Awesome — App Scaffolding Family
create-awesome.sample: Create Awesome · project factory One command. Any stack. Family of CLIs that compose templates + addons into production-ready apps — not generators that hide files, but composers that ship real code you own. Template + addons = real files. No lock-in, no hidden runtime. Sourced catalogs: Node 10+53 · Python 6+18 · V 7+11 Composer Runtime + template + addons → command Native controls. Selecting a family updates templates and addons from sourced catalogs (CNA 10+53, CPA 6+18, CVA 7+11). Commands follow each family’s CLI shape — Node ≠ Python ≠ V.
